instructions.title: Enable Airplane mode and reboot
instructions.detail: On the Kindle, enable Airplane mode and restart once before staging. Keep the Kindle registered; Fonebrew never requests or stores Amazon credentials.

instructions.title: Stage verified WinterBreak files
instructions.detail: Fylz extracts the verified archive into the user-selected Kindle root, including hidden files, using checked temporary writes.

instructions.title: Run WinterBreak on Kindle
instructions.detail: Safely eject/disconnect USB. Open the Kindle Store. When prompted, choose Yes to turn off Airplane mode, then select WinterBreak. Wait for the UI to restart.

instructions.title: Verify jailbreak and update protection
instructions.detail: Reconnect and verify the jailbreak marker, KPM/homebrew availability, and OTA protection before installing Workdeck.
